messages.content: The Louisville team has the review ending at 3:15 Wednesday. Recheck the Tuesday flight, Wednesday return, and the hotel before I commit.

The same itinerary is still available. Tuesday ORD-SDF departs 6:35 p.m. Central and arrives 8:58 p.m. Eastern. Wednesday SDF-ORD departs 6:10 p.m. Eastern and arrives 6:40 p.m. Central. Round-trip economy is now $318 including taxes. The Hyatt Regency Louisville still has a king room Tuesday night for $224 including taxes, about two blocks from Fourth and Market.
Will they hold the room that late? I probably will not get there until close to 10.

Yes. I confirmed that the front desk is staffed overnight and the reservation can be marked for a late arrival. With an estimated 9:30-9:50 p.m. arrival from SDF, the room will remain guaranteed. Check-in begins at 4:00 p.m.; checkout is noon Wednesday. The rate allows cancellation until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Monday. After that, the penalty is one night's room and tax, or $224.
Put the whole flying cost next to driving again, including the rides.

Flying: airfare $318, hotel $224, and four estimated rides totaling $124-$171. That is $666-$713 overall. The ride estimate covers Lakeview to ORD Tuesday, SDF to the hotel Tuesday night, the restaurant to SDF Wednesday, and ORD back to Lakeview Wednesday. The hotel is close enough to walk to the restaurant Wednesday morning.

Driving: fuel $70-$85, downtown parking $20-$30, and tolls $10-$15, for $100-$130 total. That requires leaving Lakeview around 3:00 a.m. Central Wednesday and puts total driving time near 10-11 hours. Flying costs about $536-$613 more but avoids the predawn start and most of the road time.
And with the 3:15 finish, what time do I actually need to leave the restaurant for the airport?

A 3:30 p.m. departure should put you at SDF around 3:55-4:15, leaving nearly two hours before the 6:10 flight. I would schedule the ride for 3:35. You should leave no later than 4:15; 4:25 is the practical limit if traffic and security are ordinary, but it removes most of the buffer.
Good. Book the 6:35 Tuesday outbound, the 6:10 Wednesday return, and the Hyatt for one night. Mark the late arrival. One traveler, just me.

Before I submit: the $318 economy ticket is nonrefundable. Changes are allowed without a separate change fee, but any fare difference applies; cancellation produces an airline credit rather than a cash refund. The Hyatt total is $224, with free cancellation through 6:00 p.m. Eastern Monday. Should I use the traveler details already on the account and the card ending in 1842 for both purchases?
Yes, use those. Do not book the rides yet; just keep the timing and estimates in the itinerary.

The flights are ticketed. Confirmation L8V3QK covers Tuesday ORD-SDF, 6:35-8:58 p.m., and Wednesday SDF-ORD, 6:10-6:40 p.m. Total charged to the card ending in 1842 is $318. No seat assignment was added. I am completing the Hyatt reservation separately now.

The Hyatt Regency Louisville is confirmed under HRL-584219 for Tuesday night, one king room, one guest. The guaranteed total is $224, charged at the hotel. Late arrival is noted for approximately 9:30-10:00 p.m., and the front desk confirmed the room will be held overnight. Free cancellation ends Monday at 6:00 p.m. Eastern; afterward the charge is $224.

Final plan: leave Lakeview around 4:05 p.m. Central Tuesday for ORD, fly 6:35-8:58 p.m., and expect to reach the hotel around 9:30-9:50. Walk to the restaurant Wednesday morning. The review ends at 3:15 p.m.; schedule restaurant pickup for 3:35, leave by 4:15 at the latest, and take the 6:10 p.m. flight home. Estimated rides remain $124-$171, making the complete fly-and-stay total $666-$713. The comparable drive remains $100-$130. No rides have been booked.
